dct_title_s: Official map of the City of San Francisco : full and complete to the present date
dct_description_sm: compiled by Wm. M. Eddy, City Surveyor ; engraved by Edwin Moody ; John B. Brady delr.
Coordinates approximate and based on Greenwich meridian.
Bar scale on map given in "Varas."
Shows city plan (including lot numbers), boundaries, waterways, original coastline, Yerba Buena Cemetery.
Tooley's dictionary of mapmakers, A-D: 216; E-J: 6.

This copy has ink inscription signed by John W. Geary, Mayor of San Francisco, and Wm. M. Eddy, City Surveyor of San Francisco, April 4th, 1851: We certify that this map has the boundary line of the Beach and Water property ...
Inscription in lower right, signed Geo. R. Turner, City & County Surveyor, June 6th 1859.
